notes: Primary PDF titles and DOIs verified against both supplied references. Page locators interpreted as PDF page numbers. The neutral description spans multiple hypotheses; the original p. 9 contains one eta-squared-family result, identifying the purchase-status by condition interaction, and the replication explicitly identifies its corresponding replication analysis. This interpretation is narrower than the general description. Replication p. 9 also reports condition and purchase-status main effects and several t tests; those do not supply the missing interaction effect or p and were not substituted. No d for the target interaction is printed. The phrase all p’s > .1 on replication p. 9 refers to point-biserial correlations, not the ANOVA interaction, so no p bound was inferred. The replication authors report successful reproduction of the separate urge pattern, but the failed verdict here concerns the selected interaction. Original PDF text extraction represents less-than and eta symbols imperfectly; the extracted original target p is an equality and is unaffected.
